limits: One evidence-backed category recovery on five independent public-guide stills is not a gameplay accuracy estimate.

Recovered Sightseer-labelled guide frame remains unnamed VIP_WORK/type_only with UNKNOWN phase and no outcome.
Literal 11:324 is an opaque OCR suffix, not a validated countdown, completion, or monetary reading.
Cayo summary retains a fresh detector completion candidate only; this evaluation does not run application episode, rearming, timer, accounting, persistence or cooldown paths.
The diagnostic makes the same six requests per image; this does not establish unchanged whole-application OCR cost after active-state recovery.
Native Windows OCR, live screen capture, GUI, actual gameplay, YouTube/video validation and other HUD layouts remain unverified.
No image, derived crop, raw pixel data or local private file path is included in this committed JSON; full bytes remain local.
No dependencies installed, network requests, browser/media retries, models or GitHub Actions used.
